title: Rupee rises 20 paise to 94.79 against US dollar during early trade
description:
The rupee appreciated 20 paise to 94.79 against the US dollar in early trade on Friday on softening of the American currency and  the positive impact of the RBI' structural forex interventions.
Lower US treasury yields also supported the domestic currency.
However, elevated crude oil prices and decline in equity markets restricted the rupee's sharp gains.
At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.75, then  touched 94.79, registering a gain of 20 paise over its previous close.
On Thursday, the rupee had appreciated 18 paise to close at 94.99 against the US dollar.
" Decline in dollar index and softening of US treasury yields also supported the rupee. However, a surge in crude oil prices capped sharp gains. On the data front, US PPI (Producer Price Index) was hotter than expected while retail sales topped forecast. Weekly unemployment claims were in line with expectations," said Anuj Choudhary, Research Analyst, Mirae Asset Sharekhan.
